name: Malaria Consortium, malaria emergency response in South Ethiopia (The Life You Can Save, 2025)
beneficiaries_note: The model's name: Malaria Consortium, malaria emergency response in South Ethiopia (The Life You Can Save, 2025).

missing_data.note: Thin: the effect is the before-and-after change in the project districts' monitoring indicators (malaria cases relative to the region's, admissions, case fatality), with no comparison group, read as a fall in incidence across the whole population.

summary: Malaria Consortium ran an emergency malaria response with the health authorities in 18 high-burden districts of South Ethiopia from mid-2024, after cases in Ethiopia rose eightfold. The Life You Can Save reads the fall in the districts' malaria indicators over the project as cases, admissions and deaths averted and estimates $225 per DALY averted. Our view values each death averted by age the site's way and credits Malaria Consortium with most but not all of the change; the biggest uncertainty is how much of the fall the project caused.

rows.label: Value of a death of a child under five averted, in healthy years
rows.explainer: **Changed for consistency.** The Life You Can Save counts a child's death averted as the child's remaining life expectancy at 2.5 years, discounted at 3%, about 28 years. The site values every death of a child under five the same way: GiveWell's moral weight (116.25 units of value), times the value-of-a-life slider, in healthy years at Your values' exchange rate (58 at the defaults).

Value of a malaria death at five or older averted, in healthy years
rows.explainer: **Changed for consistency.** The Life You Can Save counts a death at five or older as the remaining life expectancy at 25 (the average age of malaria deaths it cites, 25.9), discounted at 3%. The sheet lumps every age from five up, so our view weights GiveWell's moral weights by age by the ages of sub-Saharan Africa's malaria deaths over five (GBD 2023), times the value-of-a-life slider, in healthy years.

rows.label: Value of a malaria death at any age averted, in healthy years
rows.explainer: **Changed for consistency.** The sheet counts every death averted at the remaining life expectancy at 25, discounted at 3%; it doesn't split deaths by age. Our view takes the ages of sub-Saharan Africa's malaria deaths (GBD 2023: 63% under five) and values each band by GiveWell's moral weights, times the value-of-a-life slider.

Our healthy years for the same deaths and illness, per DALY of The Life You Can Save's
rows.explainer: The evaluator view keeps The Life You Can Save's DALYs (1).

rows.label: Share of the effect that wouldn't have happened without Malaria Consortium
rows.explainer: Our judgment, 70% (40% to 100%); the sheet credits Malaria Consortium with the whole fall. The indicator is measured against the region's malaria, which takes out the epidemic's general waning, but the health authorities and other partners responded in the same districts at the same time. Anchor: Malaria Consortium ran the emergency project with the national and regional authorities, so most but not all of the change is its work.

rows.label: Staff pay as a share of programme cost

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable jobs elsewhere
rows.explainer: Health workers and field staff at nonprofits. Our judgment.

rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources on, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost. The sheet's costs already include everyone's money for the work it credits. Off, this is 100%.
